The Satisfaction Guarantee applies under the following conditions:

Our Services Login ServiceMarket Service guarantee 150,000+ happy customers Over 15,000 reviews Rated 4.8 out of 5 Trusted service professionals Live customer support When we started ServiceMarket in 2013, our main objective was to make household chores simpler, easier and worry free.
And hopefully termites will now stay away for 5 years as guaranteed.
Contact Us Service Guarantee ServiceMarket's Satisfaction Guarantee is here to cover you for your less than satisfactory experience.

You can read below what is covered by our Satisfaction Guarantee (which is subject to terms and conditions) Our Satisfaction Guarantee covers the following If the quality of work is not up to mark, we will have the service redone once at no additional cost.
For incorrect billing, we will refund the excess charges in the original mode of payment or through Service Credits.
In the case, where the damage is irreversible, maximum coverage of up to AED500 will be provided, given that conditions of the Satisfaction Guarantee have been met.
The Satisfaction Guarantee applies under the following conditions: The work was booked and delivered through the ServiceMarket platform with a corresponding order number.

PAYMENT REFUNDS Should the Company, based on the delivery confirmation of our service partner, charge a user whereas the service was in fact not delivered, the Company will refund the full amount to the user.

Any other refunds including those listed above will be made as credits to the users registered account on ServiceMarket or onto the original mode of payment, as may be deemed appropriate by the Company.

If your booking amount was charged/reserved on your card at the time of booking creation, for late cancellations and no-shows, the pre-authorized amount will be fully or partially captured, as per the Cancellation Policy (the cancellation charges have been listed below) and the remaining amount (if any) will be refunded back to your card or through the original payment method.
